description: Solar ingress instants (sankranti) - when the Sun enters each sidereal rashi. Drives the Nepali solar month boundaries and therefore every BS date.

source.notes: UNPOPULATED. Do not fill from this engine's own output - that would be a regression baseline, and the runner rejects it. Needs a published almanac, observatory table, or an authority the maintainer designates.

tolerance.rationale: Published patro sankranti times are printed to the minute; 120 s accepts a printed-minute difference plus the ayanamsha-formula spread, which shifts an ingress instant more than it shifts a longitude.

todo: Needs 12 sankranti instants for one BS year from an authoritative Nepali patro (Nepal Panchanga Nirnayak Samiti preferred, since its dates are what the product is measured against). A BS year with a known-awkward boundary is more valuable than an easy one.
